title: P1: Paper v2 package industry blacklist needs QE-style UI without QE global coupling
description:
Expected: QE global blacklist/filtered stock pool remains QE-only. Paper v2 has a StrategyPackage-level or Paper runtime-profile/version-level industry blacklist that Selection Center and Paper v2 simulation both read. The UI should provide the same industry-tree selection experience as QE custom evolution, but in Paper v2 local/package mode with no writes to QE global blacklist and no QE stock-pool generation.
Actual: Selection Center exposes a text input that splits comma-separated industry strings into runtime_profile.industry_blacklist. Backend matching is exact against PIT industry metadata, so free-text input is fragile and cannot reliably support real customization. QE SectorBlacklistPanel has the desired selector UX but is coupled to /quantevolver/stock-pool/blacklist and /stock-pool/generate, which would incorrectly make Paper v2 modify QE global state.

trigger_condition.domain_boundary: QE global blacklist is QE-only; Paper v2 blacklist is StrategyPackage/Paper-runtime scoped and shared by Selection Center plus simulation.

reproduce_command: Open /paper-v2/selection and inspect the industry blacklist control; it is a free-text input, while QE custom evolution has an industry tree selector that is currently coupled to QE global stock-pool endpoints and must not be reused as global state for Paper v2.
required_verification: Paper v2 exposes a StrategyPackage-level or Paper runtime-profile/version-level industry blacklist config surface using a QE-style industry tree selector.
The Paper v2 selector runs in local/package mode and does not call QE global blacklist endpoints or generate QE filtered stock pools.
The persisted config is associated with package_id plus version/hash/activation metadata so historical Selection/Paper runs can prove which blacklist was used.
Selection Center uses the package-level Paper v2 blacklist by default and supports explicit per-run override, clear, or append semantics without silent package-default mutation.
Paper v2 simulation/readiness/day-run/live paths use the same resolved package-level blacklist as Selection Center.
The config stores canonical industry level/code/name and backend matching uses canonical values instead of hand-entered text.
QE experiments, QE global blacklist, QE stock pools, QE backtests, and frozen StrategyPackage manifests are not modified by Paper v2 blacklist edits.
Tests cover Selection exclusion, Paper v2 consistency, absence of QE global endpoint writes, and historical run config persistence.
Validation record includes DESIGN-COMPLIANCE-001 and production gate reporting; if DB DDL is required, production_ddl_gate must be applied_and_verified after merge before runtime activation.
closure_requirements: Paper v2 industry blacklist is scoped to StrategyPackage/Paper runtime configuration, not AIstock global and not QE global.
Selection Center and Paper v2 simulation share the same Paper v2 package blacklist resolution contract.
Operator UI provides QE-style industry selection without free-text as the main path.
QE global blacklist and filtered stock pools remain untouched by Paper v2 configuration.
Historical runs persist enough config identity to reproduce which blacklist was used.
non_goals: Do not reuse QE global blacklist state for Paper v2.
Do not write Paper v2 blacklist changes into frozen StrategyPackage manifests.
Do not change QE experiment/backtest behavior.
